rationale: Mufaddal brings deep embedded systems and automotive software expertise across Linux, Bluetooth, and OTA architecture, while Kshitij specializes in semiconductor IP verification with protocol expertise in AXI and I3C—complementary skill sets where embedded systems design and chip-level verification intersect. Kshitij is actively hiring for IP/CPU verification talent, and Mufaddal's background in automotive-grade embedded software and connectivity protocols could offer useful perspective on real-world protocol implementation and system-level verification challenges.
intro_message: mufaddal.esmael@gmail.com, meet KSHITIJ GUPTA — he's a design verification engineer at NVIDIA working on semiconductor protocols (AXI, I3C) and is hiring for verification roles; your automotive embedded and connectivity background could offer useful real-world context for protocol and system verification.
